questions.question: What does the LORD do to the earth in Isaiah 24?
options: Lays it waste and scatters its inhabitants
Gathers its peoples into one great city
Renews it with rivers and green pastures
Fills it with peace and abundant harvest
questions.answer: Lays it waste and scatters its inhabitants

questions.question: Why is the earth defiled, according to Isaiah 24?
options: The earth itself has grown old and worn out with the passing of ages
Its inhabitants have transgressed the laws and broken the everlasting covenant
The nations have all risen up and warred against one another without ever ceasing
A great and lasting drought has dried up all of its flowing rivers
questions.answer: Its inhabitants have transgressed the laws and broken the everlasting covenant
